(2) After a quick jump cut, they appear in coordinated outfits: white crop tops with purple and light blue athletic wear. The studio lighting shifts to a vibrant pink/purple hue as they begin a synchronized dance routine. (3) They perform a series of energetic, rhythmic movements involving sharp arm gestures, hip sways, and turns. The background lighting changes dynamically from pink to green and back to white, highlighting their movements. They conclude the sequence with synchronized poses, looking confidently into the lens under bright studio lights.
